html:
A road across the Brazilian Amazon from east to west, officially opened on 27 September 1972 and some 4,000 kilometres long. It was a flagship project of Brazil's military government.

The generals wanted to tie the empty seeming north to the rest of the nation, to guard the border, and to give land to poor farmers from the drought-stricken northeast, under the slogan "a land without men for men without land". Settlers were promised plots along the road.

Much went wrong. Large parts were never paved and turn to mud in the rainy season. The rainforest soils were poor for crops, and many settlers left. But the road opened the way for loggers, ranchers and miners. Clearing spread out from it in the "fishbone" pattern seen from space, and it brought disease and conflict to Indigenous peoples. It marked the start of the large scale clearing of the Amazon rainforest, the cause later taken up by Chico Mendes.
sum: A road across the Brazilian Amazon from east to west, officially opened on 27 September 1972 and some 4,000 kilometres long. It was a flagship project of Brazil's military government.
